matrix_note: Plano 0.4.39 source b13ddd632bde1fea7678386c345665ea5fa671af: SupportedAPIsFromClient accepts Chat, Responses and Messages only. Gemini provider uses OpenAI compatibility, not native Gemini wire; it explicitly selects the Chat upstream for all three ingress protocols, while the OpenAI provider selects Responses for Responses ingress. Bedrock model enables three Converse translations. Recorder and response-content checks prove eight pairs. No Cohere adapter or native Gemini/Bedrock ingress exists in the supported API enums. Corrected standard Responses mock fields are required. Evidence: results/diagnostics/refresh-configuration/plano-protocol-preflight.json
